request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:UNDEAD:FARM

layers.text: Change only two things. Make the orange-brown earth a dark dusty grey-brown (#5d5552), a flat thin patch with no thick side walls under it. Make the gravestones and the crypt walls a lighter slate blue-grey (#8b92a3) with a mid slate shade (#6a7082). Keep the crypt, its near-black roof and violet door, the bare tree, the cross, the fence, the size, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
